intro.text: A Thaylen member of the Diagram who travels with Graves and Moash.

items.text: A devout follower of the Passions, Febrth was recruited by the Diagram and travelled with Fia, Moash and Graves across the Frostlands toward Kharbranth. One evening he argued with Graves about their route, sure the Passions would guide them south. That same night their camp was ambushed and Febrth was killed.

appearance.text: Thaylen, but with the red hair of an Unkalaki, a sign of mixed heritage.

personality.text: His faith in the Passions is unshakeable; though the Diagram asks members to give up their old beliefs, he insists he can hold both.
He is a terrible cook: his stew looks like mush and tastes of crem.
